description: Required parameters are stable_id, action, expected_revision and a nonblank reason. action=set creates an absent record and explicitly passes expected_revision=null; action=correct patches the supplied values on an existing record; action=clear supplies clear_fields to make optional fields null; action=retire changes active to retired; action=reopen changes retired to active. Existing-record actions require the current positive integer expected_revision from read_model_catalog_policy. Correct/clear preserve the lifecycle state, including retired state. Only set/correct accept values, and values must omit nulls; only clear accepts a nonempty list clear_fields. The server derives the current Operator identity; no actor parameter is accepted. A single StateManagementInterface transaction claims the expected revision, changes the current projection and appends a full immutable history snapshot with revision_id, expected_revision, predecessor_revision_id, actor, reason, action, recorded_at and lifecycle_state. Stale premises or a history failure roll back the whole change. Retirement is reversible through reopen and history is retained. values may set/correct any of these optional policy fields: dispatch_score_margin, cost_tie_tolerance, confidence_level, interval_method, interval_method_revision, bootstrap_resamples, outcome_window_hours, staleness_window_hours, refresh_interval_seconds and refresh_dedupe_seconds. clear_fields may name any of those fields. Unset or cleared settings remain null with no replacement numeric defaults. Typed numerical values must be finite; confidence_level is a probability strictly between its endpoints, bootstrap_resamples is a positive integer, outcome/staleness windows and refresh cadence are positive, and margin/tolerance/deduplication values are nonnegative. Method identifiers and method revisions are nonblank strings. This configuration is independent of set_model_cells_enabled and does not alter catalog cell enablement, acceptance or eligibility. Use read_model_catalog_policy with kind=policy and the same stable_id for current/history readback.
embedding_description: Create, correct, clear, retire or reopen versioned catalog policy using the current Operator identity and an explicit expected revision. Preserve immutable history and null absent numerical settings, with atomic revision claims and independent model cell enablement.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: current complete typed snapshot with provenance and the new revision; the matching full history snapshot committed atomically.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show stable identity, current revision and lifecycle state; retain immutable history and predecessor provenance. Present missing optional settings as null and preserve warnings without inventing numeric defaults. Source credentials appear only as references.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use read_model_catalog_policy with the matching kind and stable_id to inspect current and explicit paginated history before another revision-checked action. Clearing is absence, and retirement can be reversed by reopen; neither changes model cell enablement.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Typed catalog policy/source configuration through StateManagementInterface; no network fetch, live schema application, credential resolution, deployment or session lifecycle action.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: parameter_invalid: correct the action, declared field types, nonblank stable_id/reason, explicit expected_revision, values or clear_fields; use clear to remove optional values. stale_catalog_revision: read the current record and decide again with its revision; initial set requires an absent record and expected_revision=null, and no stale write partially commits. invalid_transition: retire only an active record or reopen only a retired record; read its current lifecycle_state first. operator_required: invoke from the currently bound Operator session. operator_identity_spoofed: remove supplied actor, agent_session_id and agent_instance_id; identity is server-derived, never a parameter. state_service_unavailable: restore the state-service binding and retry the explicit request after checking current state.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: parameter_invalid: correct the action, declared field types, nonblank stable_id/reason, explicit expected_revision, values or clear_fields; use clear to remove optional values. stale_catalog_revision: read the current record and decide again with its revision; initial set requires an absent record and expected_revision=null, and no stale write partially commits. invalid_transition: retire only an active record or reopen only a retired record; read its current lifecycle_state first. operator_required: invoke from the currently bound Operator session. operator_identity_spoofed: remove supplied actor, agent_session_id and agent_instance_id; identity is server-derived, never a parameter. state_service_unavailable: restore the state-service binding and retry the explicit request after checking current state.
